rationale: The stock is trading at the extreme top of its intraday range (95.3%) after a 5% gap up, with price pinned to the session high and recent 1-minute candles showing low volume consolidation rather than breakout momentum. Entering long here offers a poor risk-reward ratio due to the proximity of the high (limited upside before resistance) and the elevated risk of a mean reversion pullback toward the VWAP ($13.06) or 9-EMA ($12.90), while shorting into a strong gap-up trend with high relative volume (4.12x) carries significant adverse selection risk.
